pages.text: Bones and skulls are, unsurprisingly, good at channeling necrotic energies alongside shade stone. With the Osseous Focus, you've created an ossuary that can summon loyal Skeleton Servants on demand.

The gravestone requires a Bone Meal to be added, in order to call forth a Skeleton Servant. Much like the Spider Nest, right-clicking the nest with a Wand or Staff will make it so that it will only spawn a servant if a valid target is near it. While crouching, however, it will change whether the servant will spawn guarding the block or following the owner.
Depending on its surroundings, much like $(l:rituals/dark_altar)Altars$(), the servant can spawn as a different variant from a regular Skeleton.

pages.title: Stray Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a snowy biome $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)20 Snow Any $(li)8 Ice Any

pages.title: Mossy Skeleton Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a Jungle $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)20 Vines $(li)8 Leaves

pages.title: Rattled Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is exposed to an active thunderstorm $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)1 Lightning Rod $(li)8 Blocks of Copper

pages.title: Skeleton Pillager Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a Pillager Outpost $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)15 Dark Oak Logs $(li)4 Carved Pumpkins or Targets

pages.title: Wither Skeleton Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a Nether Fortress $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)32 Nether Bricks Any $(li)8 Nether Warts
